result.title: Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention
result.summary: Motor imagery (MI) enables a brain-computer interface (BCI) to decode movement intentions without overt movement. Hybrid electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) classification combines complementary signals, but inter-subject variability and the design of information exchange between modalities affect generalization to new subjects. We propose a framework that combines Cross-Subject Class Mixup (CSCM) with Selective Attention. CSCM aims to construct new training data to make the model robust against inter-subject variability. It independently selects EEG and fNIRS donor trials from other training subjects within the anchor class and mixes each modality while preserving the original label. Selective Attention provides an effective way to simultaneously model the temporal signal characteristics and fuse the two modalities. It retains causal temporal self-attention for EEG and uses a classification token (CLS) to integrate both modalities, without fNIRS attention updates or direct cross-modal temporal-token attention. Leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation across 28 subjects on a public EEG-fNIRS dataset yields a mean balanced accuracy (BA) of 76.85% and a macro-averaged F1 score (Macro-F1) of 76.58%. The proposed model achieves the highest mean performance among five reimplemented baselines. We also examine the contributions of CSCM and Selective Attention through modality-specific mixing and donor-policy comparisons, temporal-policy comparisons, interventions on direct cross-modal paths, and component ablations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出将跨被试类别 Mixup（CSCM）与选择注意力结合的运动想象分类框架，用于 EEG-fNIRS 双模态解码；在 28 名被试的 LOSO 评估中平均性能高于五个复现基线，并通过模态混合策略、时序策略、跨模态路径干预和组件消融分析各组成部分的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「EEG 保留因果时序自注意力、仅由 CLS 整合两模态、不做直接跨模态 token 注意力」的非对称融合设计与跨模态路径干预消融，可能为核查 VLM 中视觉证据是否被旁路、模态信息如何汇入潜在推理状态提供方法线索，需读原文确认。
